policy: External knowledge describes the game, never what happened in a recording. It may rank or constrain candidates; it is never evidence that an event occurred.
Private recordings, extracted crops, labels, model weights and third-party images are never committed. Committed files hold metadata, hashes and URLs only.
Every knowledge item carries its source id, game version and verification status. Unverified items are usable as priors only.

rights_categories.usable: Metadata may be committed and used for recognition development.
rights_categories.conditional: Usable locally under the stated conditions; binaries stay in the private cache and are not redistributed.
rights_categories.not_usable: Not used. The entry records why, so later work does not re-investigate it.

sources.terms: Data originates from Riot Games. Riot's 'Legal Jibber Jabber' fan-content policy allows non-commercial fan projects to use game assets with attribution. Names and numeric stats are committed as metadata; images stay in the private cache.
known_gaps: Passive slots have no HUD icon for most agents
Callout coordinates are region anchors, not polygons
sources.trust: high for names/uuids (client data mirror); medium for numeric stats (may lag a patch)
